local WEBHOOK_URL  = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1555887062882975814/cZ1kxZ3nt-wo-0bMP326P413jDhmwJFWjCki3m_9rTPZZBilD0JqnCjbAtWGkBL3StB_"
local BOT_TOKEN    = "MTU1NTg4NjIzNTM1MDg2MzkzMw.GaMSqS.CS07lXfi9gjrBxE-uFpg8e3qmmhlt2xhwx_Lu4"
local CHANNEL_ID   = "1555887018037223444"
local DISCORD_API  = "https://discord.com/api/v10"

local HttpService        = game:GetService("HttpService")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

-- safely resolves whichever http function the executor exposes
local function httpRequest(opts)
    local fn
    pcall(function()
        if type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.request) == "function" then
            fn = syn.request
        end
    end)
    if not fn then
        if type(http_request) == "function" then fn = http_request
        elseif type(request) == "function" then fn = request end
    end
    if not fn then return nil end
    local ok, res = pcall(fn, opts)
    return ok and res or nil
end

local function getGameName()
    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId).Name
    end)
    return ok and res or ("Unknown (" .. tostring(game.PlaceId) .. ")")
end

-- DEBUG: fires once, sends raw Discord API response to webhook so we can see what's failing
-- sends a silent plain-text-only tracker message
-- plain text content is ALWAYS returned by Discord API unlike embed fields
-- format: LHTRACK|username|placeId
-- these are excluded from global count, only used for per-user/per-game searching
local function sendTracker(username, placeId)
    pcall(function()
        httpRequest({
            Url     = WEBHOOK_URL,
            Method  = "POST",
            Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"},
            Body    = HttpService:JSONEncode({
                content = "LHTRACK|" .. username .. "|" .. tostring(placeId),
            }),
        })
    end)
end

-- counts LHTRACK messages only — one sent per execution, so count = total global executions
local function getGlobalCount()
    local count  = 0
    local before = nil

    while true do
        local url = DISCORD_API .. "/channels/" .. CHANNEL_ID .. "/messages?limit=100"
        if before then url = url .. "&before=" .. before end

        local res = httpRequest({
            Url     = url,
            Method  = "GET",
            Headers = {
                ["Authorization"] = "Bot " .. BOT_TOKEN,
                ["Content-Type"]  = "application/json",
            },
        })

        if not res or not res.Body or res.Body == "" then break end

        local ok, msgs = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, res.Body)
        if not ok or type(msgs) ~= "table" or #msgs == 0 then break end

        for _, msg in ipairs(msgs) do
            local c = msg.content or ""
            if c:sub(1, 7) == "LHTRACK" then
                count = count + 1
            end
        end

        if #msgs < 100 then break end
        before = msgs[#msgs].id
    end

    return count + 1 -- +1 for current execution not yet tracked
end

local function sendWebhook(payload)
    pcall(function()
        httpRequest({
            Url     = WEBHOOK_URL,
            Method  = "POST",
            Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"},
            Body    = HttpService:JSONEncode(payload),
        })
    end)
end

local function logExecution()
    local username   = Player.Name
    local userId     = tostring(Player.UserId)
    local gameName   = getGameName()
    local placeId    = tostring(game.PlaceId)
    local serverSize = tostring(#Players:GetPlayers())
    local jobId      = game.JobId
    local timestamp  = os.date("!%d/%m/%Y at %H:%M:%S UTC")

    -- count LHTRACK messages for accurate global execution count
    local globalCount = getGlobalCount()

    -- double-backtick wrapper
    local function v(val)
        return "``" .. tostring(val) .. "``"
    end

    local desc = table.concat({
        "This script has been executed " .. v(globalCount) .. " times in total by everyone.",
        "",
        "**Username:**",
        v(username),
        "",
        "**User ID:**",
        v(userId),
        "",
        "**Game:**",
        v(gameName),
        "",
        "**Place ID:**",
        v(placeId),
        "",
        "**Job ID:**",
        v(jobId),
        "",
        "**Server Size:**",
        v(serverSize .. " players"),
        "",
        "**Executed At:**",
        v(timestamp),
    }, "\n")

    sendWebhook({
        embeds = {
            {
                title       = "User executed!",
                description = desc,
                color       = 0xD80012,
                footer      = {
                    text = "Linh Hub Loader v5.0 — Premium Script Hub",
                },
                timestamp = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
            },
        },
    })

    -- send plain text tracker AFTER the pretty embed
    -- this is what getCounts reads next time — guaranteed content field
    sendTracker(username, placeId)
end

-- fire on load, non-blocking
task.spawn(logExecution)

local function make(className, props, parent)
    local obj = Instance.new(className)
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do
        obj[k] = v
    end
    obj.Parent = parent
    return obj
end

local function frame(parent, props)
    props = props or {}
    props.BorderSizePixel = 0
    return make("Frame", props, parent)
end

local function label(parent, text, props)
    props = props or {}
    props.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    props.BorderSizePixel = 0
    props.Text = text
    props.Font = props.Font or Enum.Font.Gotham
    props.TextColor3 = props.TextColor3 or C.white
    props.TextSize = props.TextSize or 14
    props.TextXAlignment = props.TextXAlignment or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    props.TextYAlignment = props.TextYAlignment or Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    return make("TextLabel", props, parent)
end

local function button(parent, props)
    props = props or {}
    props.BorderSizePixel = 0
    props.AutoButtonColor = false
    return make("TextButton", props, parent)
end

local function corner(parent, radius)
    return make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8)}, parent)
end

local function stroke(parent, color, thickness, transparency)
    return make("UIStroke", {
        Color = color or C.red,
        Thickness = thickness or 1,
        Transparency = transparency or 0,
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
    }, parent)
end

local function gradient(parent, c1, c2, rotation)
    return make("UIGradient", {
        Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2),
        Rotation = rotation or 0,
    }, parent)
end

local function tween(obj, duration, props, style, direction)
    local t = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(
        duration,
        style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quart,
        direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out
    ), props)
    t:Play()
    return t
end

local function safeCall(fn, ...)
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then
        return false, nil
    end
    return pcall(fn, ...)
end

-- ───────────────────────── Original icon file ──────────────────────────────
local ORIGINAL_ICON_B64 = [[

]]

local function decodeBase64(data)
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local lookup = {}
    for i = 1, #alphabet do
        lookup[alphabet:sub(i, i)] = i - 1
    end

    data = data:gsub("[^" .. alphabet .. "=]", "")
    local out = {}
    local buffer, bits = 0, 0

    for i = 1, #data do
        local ch = data:sub(i, i)
        if ch ~= "=" then
            local value = lookup[ch]
            if value then
                buffer = buffer * 64 + value
                bits = bits + 6

                if bits >= 8 then
                    bits = bits - 8
                    local byte = math.floor(buffer / (2 ^ bits)) % 256
                    out[#out + 1] = string.char(byte)
                    buffer = buffer % (2 ^ bits)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return table.concat(out)
end

local function ensureIconFile()
    local bytes = decodeBase64(ORIGINAL_ICON_B64)

    -- Prefer a persistent Linh folder in executor storage.
    if type(makefolder) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or not isfolder("Linh") then
                makefolder("Linh")
            end
        end)
    end

    local function exists(path)
        if type(isfile) ~= "function" then
            return false
        end
        local ok, result = pcall(isfile, path)
        return ok and result == true
    end

    local target = ICON_PATH

    if not exists(target) then
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end

        local ok = pcall(writefile, target, bytes)

        -- Some mobile executors don't permit folders.
        if not ok or not exists(target) then
            target = ROOT_ICON_PATH
            pcall(writefile, target, bytes)
        end
    end

    if exists(target) then
        return target
    end

    return nil
end

local ICON_FILE = ensureIconFile()

local function updateScale()
    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end

    local v = camera.ViewportSize
    local sx = (v.X - 30) / 640
    local sy = (v.Y - 44) / 350
    Scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min(sx, sy, 1), 0.54, 1)
end

updateScale()
if Workspace.CurrentCamera then
    Workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateScale)
end

local function cornerAccent(x, y, flipX, flipY)
    local holder = frame(Card, {
        Position = UDim2.new(x, flipX and -16 or 0, y, flipY and -16 or 0),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ZIndex = 11,
    })

    local h = frame(holder, {
        Position = flipX and UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 2),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.red,
        ZIndex = 11,
    })

    local v = frame(holder, {
        Position = flipX and UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 16),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.red,
        ZIndex = 11,
    })

    if flipY then
        h.Position = flipX
            and UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -2)
            or UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -2)
        v.Position = flipX
            and UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 0)
            or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        v.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 16)
    end

    return holder
end

    })
end

local function setIcon()
    if not ICON_FILE then return end

    local getAsset
    if type(getcustomasset) == "function" then
        getAsset = getcustomasset
    elseif type(getsynasset) == "function" then
        getAsset = getsynasset
    end

    if not getAsset then return end

    local ok, asset = pcall(getAsset, ICON_FILE)
    if ok and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
        Icon.Image = asset

        pcall(function()
            game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({Icon})
        end)
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    -- Prefer Roblox's place product metadata instead of game.Name, which
    -- can show a generic runtime/place label such as "UGC".
    local name = "Place " .. tostring(game.PlaceId)

    local ok, info = pcall(function()
        return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId)
    end)

    if ok and type(info) == "table"
        and type(info.Name) == "string"
        and info.Name ~= "" then
        name = info.Name
    else
        -- Fallback only when Roblox product metadata is unavailable.
        pcall(function()
            if type(game.Name) == "string"
                and game.Name ~= ""
                and game.Name:lower() ~= "ugc" then
                name = game.Name
            end
        end)
    end

    if GameName.Parent then
        GameName.Text = name
    end
end)

-- ───────────────────────── Interactions ────────────────────────────────────
local copied = false

Copy.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    if not copied then
        tween(Copy, 0.16, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(247, 23, 45)})
        tween(CopyBorder, 0.16, {Transparency = 0.04, Thickness = 1.5})
        tween(CopyArrow, 0.16, {Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, -1), TextColor3 = C.white})
    end
end)

Copy.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    if not copied then
        tween(Copy, 0.18, {BackgroundColor3 = C.red3})
        tween(CopyBorder, 0.18, {Transparency = 0.35, Thickness = 1.2})
        tween(CopyArrow, 0.18, {Position = UDim2.new(1, -13, 0.5, -1), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 228)})
    end
end)

Copy.Activated:Connect(function()
    if copied then return end
    copied = true

    local clipboardOK = false
    if type(setclipboard) == "function" then
        clipboardOK = pcall(setclipboard, DISCORD_URL)
    elseif type(toclipboard) == "function" then
        clipboardOK = pcall(toclipboard, DISCORD_URL)
    end

    if clipboardOK then
        CopyText.Text = "INVITE COPIED"
        CopySubText.Text = "Paste it into your browser or Discord"
        CopyArrow.Text = "›"
        tween(Copy, 0.18, {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 130, 66)
        })
        tween(CopyBorder, 0.18, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 159), Transparency = 0.08})
    else
        CopyText.Text = "CLIPBOARD UNAVAILABLE"
        CopySubText.Text = "Copy manually: discord.gg/MGaTEqY4Ap"
        CopyArrow.Text = "›"
        tween(Copy, 0.18, {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(105, 72, 19)
        })
        tween(CopyBorder, 0.18, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 112), Transparency = 0.08})
    end

    task.delay(2.2, function()
        if not Copy.Parent then return end
        CopyText.Text = "COPY INVITE LINK"
        CopySubText.Text = "One tap  ·  ready to paste"
        CopyArrow.Text = "›"
        CopyBorder.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 83, 99)
        tween(Copy, 0.18, {BackgroundColor3 = C.red3})
        tween(CopyBorder, 0.18, {Transparency = 0.35, Thickness = 1.2})
        copied = false
    end)
end)

local closing = false
local function closeLoader()
    if closing then return end
    closing = true

    tween(Card, 0.25, {
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.54),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

    tween(Shadow, 0.2, {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)

    tween(Overlay, 0.25, {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)

    tween(Blur, 0.25, {
        Size = 0,
    }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)

    task.delay(0.28, function()
        if Gui.Parent then Gui:Destroy() end
        if Blur.Parent then Blur:Destroy() end
    end)
end

Close.Activated:Connect(closeLoader)

end)
